'''Wasteland Tech's Armor''' was a type of protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[March 28]], [[2023]].<ref name="Reveal" />
